title: Figure 10: Slit-imaging Ghost Interference setup for superluminal/retrocausal signaling
description: Color optical schematic similar to Figure 7 but with two coiled "10 km" fiber-optic runs inserted between image slits S2 and "Destination Apertures" S3 with a switch and detectors, alongside the Argon Ion Laser, BBO crystal, polarizing splitter, object slits S1 and "Camera" with "0"/"1" pattern plots.
